intent: A stats card for "Cart Sales": a header row with the shoppingCart icon and the metric name as a caption, the value 7310 as USD currency, then a row with the arrowForward icon and "+12.5% from last quarter". Keep the name, icons, value and percentage in the data model.
reference_express:
surface("gallery-stats-card", sendDataModel=true)
$/icon = "shoppingCart"
$/metricName = "Cart Sales"
$/trendIcon = "arrowForward"
$/trendPercent = 12.5
$/value = 7310
root = Card(main_column)
main_column = Column([header, value, trend_row])
header = Row([metric_icon, metric_name], _, "center")
metric_icon = Icon($/icon)
metric_name = Text($/metricName, "caption")
value = Text(formatCurrency($/value, "USD"))
trend_row = Row([trend_icon, trend_text], _, "center")
trend_icon = Icon($/trendIcon)
trend_text = Text(formatString("+${/trendPercent}% from last quarter"), "body")
